The AlleyWatch Startup Daily Funding Report: 9/14/2026

by AlleyWatch
Share on FacebookShare on Twitter
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:06
Instaread

The latest venture capital, seed, pre-seed, and angel deals for New York City startups for September 14, 2026 featuring funding details for Highstock, UrgentIQ, Pave Finance, Rogo, and much more. This page will be updated throughout the day to reflect any new fundings.

Highstock – $30M

E-Commerce

Highstock, an AI-powered B2B marketplace that connects consumer brands with vetted global wholesale buyers to discreetly sell excess inventory without relying on traditional liquidation channels, has raised $30M in Series A funding led by Andreessen Horowitz with participation from Greylock Partners, Abstract, Daybreak ventures, Max Mullen, Lenny Rachitsky, and JJ Zhuang. Founded by Camille van Horne and Sean Cashin in 2024, Highstock has raised $35.5M in total equity funding to date.

UrgentIQ – $15M

HealthTech

UrgentIQ, an AI-native electronic medical record (EMR) and clinical operating platform purpose-built for urgent care centers, has raised $15M in Series A funding led by Five Elms Capital. Founded by Nat Gibbs and Eric Slater in 2022, UrgentIQ has raised $24.5M in total equity funding to date.

Pave Finance – $15M

FinTech

Pave Finance, an AI-powered portfolio management platform that enables registered investment advisors to customize, personalize, and automate portfolio construction and management at scale, has raised $15M in Series A funding. The round included investment from advisory firms, former executive officers and board members of leading financial services firms in the U.S., and company insiders. Founded by Pascal Cevaer-Corey, Peter Corey, and Stephen Evans in 2020, Pave Finance has raised $29M in total equity funding to date.

Rogo – $30M

FinTech

Rogo, a generative AI platform purpose-built for financial institutions that automates research, workflows, and document creation across investment banking, private equity, hedge funds, and asset management, has raised $30M in venture funding from Barclays, Opera Tech Ventures, Citi Ventures, MUFG Innovation Partners, Societe Generale S.A., and Joshua Easterly. Founded by Gabriel Stengel, John Willett, and Tumas Rackaitis in 2021, Rogo has raised $344M in total equity funding to date.
